nodes.speaker: Mrs Webb
nodes.text: Oh Edmund, love. We came as soon as we heard. I've got a pot of broth on. You'll eat.

nodes.speaker: Mrs Webb
nodes.text: Thomas has been so brave. He put Rosie to bed himself. Told her Clara had gone visiting.

nodes.speaker: Edmund
nodes.text: She'll need to know the truth eventually.

nodes.speaker: Mrs Webb
nodes.text: Not tonight she won't. Let the child sleep.

choices.text: Thank you, Margaret. I don't know what we'd do without you.
I need to go back out. There's something I have to find.
Leave me alone. All of you.

nodes.speaker: Mrs Webb
nodes.text: She loved you very much, Edmund. You know that. Whatever happens next — that was real.
nodes.journal_entry: The neighbours came. People who knew Clara. She was loved. I keep forgetting that.

nodes.speaker: Mrs Webb
nodes.text: Edmund — please. Not tonight. Your children need to see their father, not an empty chair.

nodes.speaker: Mrs Webb
nodes.text: ...Of course. I'll leave the broth on the step.
nodes.journal_entry: I sent them away. Good people who loved her. What am I becoming?
